::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Founded 2022 in Ahmedabad by Nikul Shah and Jinal Shah. Entered via RF/SiP modules (Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, LoRa — 15+ certified modules, tens of thousands of deployments) to fund a longer-term push toward an indigenous, low-cost general-purpose SoC aimed at the ultra-cheap chip segment India currently imports from China. Signed an OSAT collaboration MoU with Kaynes Semicon (Sept 2026) covering package qualification, assembly/testing, and co-development.
:::

## What does this firm design?

RF/SiP connectivity modules for smart metering and smart-city applications, and the ISC-VEGA-SOM — a module built around its own ISC-R1 quad-core AI processor with integrated LoRa connectivity.
